source: midimap_MIXTOURPRO.pdf (manufacturer MIDI map, 2 pages) + hardware corrections; see sources

deck_channels.convention: 1-based MIDI channels. Rows below are deck 1 (N = ch 1, P = ch 5, E = ch 9) and global (G = ch 16). Deck d uses N = d, P = 4 + d, E = 8 + d. The right-hand side of the unit is deck 2 (or 4 after MODE+LOAD), the left-hand side deck 1 (or 3).

keys.N: Deck transport + mixer (deck 1..4 = MIDI ch 1..4, hex 00..03)
keys.P: Deck other functions: pads, mode, load (deck 1..4 = ch 5..8, hex 04..07)
keys.E: FX unit per deck (deck 1..4 = ch 9..12, hex 08..0B)

led_coding.single_led: OFF = 00, DIM = 01, ON = 7F (NEURAL MIX, HEADPHONE CUE); DIM = 00, ON = 7F (MODE, SPLIT); FX ON: OFF = 00, DIM = 01, ON = 02, FLASH = 7F; VU: CC 1F value 00..06 segments

sources.ref: Reloop Mixtour Pro operation manual REV 1.0, 246959_Reloop_IM.pdf, English pp. 3-7 (reloop.com/media/catalog/product/pdf/2/4/6/246959_Reloop_IM.pdf)

controls.name: master_volume
controls.function: Adjusts the master output level (RCA MAIN OUT) [IM].

controls.name: browse_turn
controls.function: Scroll the library / track list [IM]. Relative encoder, one message per detent (01..7F relative; software normalizes to +/-1 row) [MM][HW].

controls.name: browse_turn_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + turn: second scroll layer, separate CC [MM]. djay use not stated in [IM]; the silkscreen next to the encoder reads BACK (shift icon) and SEEK (mode icon) [LBL].

controls.name: browse_turn_mode
controls.function: MODE + turn: SEEK, scrub through the track currently loaded on that side's deck [IM][LBL]. While a loop is active: moves the LOOP OUT point instead [LL][FORUM]. Sent on the N channel of the deck whose MODE button is held (left MODE = left deck, right MODE = right deck), so it addresses a deck, not the library.

controls.name: browse_press
controls.function: Press: confirm the selection / open the highlighted item [IM].

controls.name: browse_press_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + press: BACK, go up one level in the library menu [IM][LBL].

controls.name: load
controls.function: Load the highlighted track to this side's active deck (1 or 3 on the left, 2 or 4 on the right) [IM].

controls.name: load_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + LOAD: left button moves LEFT through the My Collection library sections, right button moves RIGHT [IM].

controls.name: load_mode
controls.function: MODE + LOAD: switch this side between decks 1/2 and 3/4 (toggle; the DECK 3 / DECK 4 LED next to the button lights for the upper deck) [IM][LBL]. Reported on the N channel as note 08 with 00 = deck 1/2, 7F = deck 3/4 [MM].

controls.name: deck_active_led
controls.function: Indicator only: lit when this side is switched to deck 3 (left) or deck 4 (right) [LBL][MM]. Hardware-driven (HW) and also settable by software on N note 08: 00 = deck 1/2 off, 7F = deck 3/4 lit [MM].

controls.name: split
controls.function: Toggle SPLIT: the 8 pads are divided, pads 1-4 control the left channel and pads 5-8 the right channel, each in its own pad mode ('splits pad modes into two rows') [IM][MM].

controls.name: split_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + SPLIT: second-layer address exists in the map [MM]; function not documented in [IM] or on the label.

controls.name: mode
controls.function: Hold MODE: the 8 pads become the pad-mode selector (press a pad to pick the mode printed under it). MODE + another button = the mode-icon second-layer function printed on the label [IM]. Stateful, toggles on release [MM]. Note on P channel, so each side has its own MODE.

controls.name: mode_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + MODE: separate address [MM]; no function documented in [IM]. SHIFT+MODE+button combos (loop move, tempo steps) are documented on the buttons themselves.

controls.name: pad_1
controls.function: Performance pad 1 in the current pad mode (see pad-mode table). All 8 pad notes exist on EVERY deck's P channel [HW]; the firmware sends a pad on the channel of the deck the pad bank is assigned to: unsplit, the deck of the side whose MODE picked the mode; with SPLIT on, pads 1-4 on the left deck and 5-8 on the right deck [IM]. Pad numbering inside a split bank is unmeasured (ASSUMED unchanged).

controls.name: pad_1_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + pad 1: mode-dependent second function. Hot Cue: delete cue 1. Pitch Cue: switch cue point. Saved Loops: trigger saved loop 1 [IM]. Sends a DIFFERENT note than the base pad and lights a separate LED bank [HW].

controls.name: pad_1_mode
controls.function: MODE + pad 1: select pad mode HOT CUE (label printed under the pad) [IM][LBL]. Mode-select notes hardware-captured as column-major, on the P channel of the deck whose MODE is held [HW].

controls.name: gain
controls.function: Channel gain / trim for this deck [IM].

controls.name: neural_mix
controls.function: Toggle the three EQ knobs of this channel between the standard 3-band EQ and Neural Mix stem control (HIGH = VOCALS, MID = HARMONIC, LOW = DRUMS) [IM][LBL].

controls.name: neural_mix_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + N on channel 1/3: TOGGLE 4-DECK WAVEFORMS view. SHIFT + N on channel 2/4: TOGGLE NEXT VIEW MODE [LL].

controls.name: eq_high
controls.function: HIGH band of the 3-band EQ; with Neural Mix (N) on, the VOCALS stem level of this deck instead [IM][LBL].

controls.name: eq_mid
controls.function: MID band of the 3-band EQ; with Neural Mix (N) on, the HARMONIC stem level of this deck instead [IM][LBL].

controls.name: eq_low
controls.function: LOW band of the 3-band EQ; with Neural Mix (N) on, the DRUMS stem level of this deck instead [IM][LBL].

controls.name: vu_meter
controls.function: Channel level meter, 7 segments, output only: software sends CC 1F with value 00..06 = number of segments lit [MM][HW].

controls.name: filter
controls.function: Bipolar filter: off at 12 o'clock, clockwise = high-pass (HPF), counter-clockwise = low-pass (LPF) [IM][LBL].

controls.name: channel_fader
controls.function: Channel volume for this deck [IM].

controls.name: channel_fader_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + move line fader: FADER START. Sends a note with CUE = 00 when the fader is closed (deck cues) and PLAY = 7F when opened (deck plays) [MM].

controls.name: headphone_cue
controls.function: Pre-fader listen: route this channel to the headphones [IM].

controls.name: headphone_cue_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + left cue button: CFX, toggles Crossfader FX (Crossfader Fusion). SHIFT + right cue button: CFX TEMPO, toggles tempo blend for the Crossfader FX [IM][LBL].

controls.name: fx_on
controls.function: Spring paddle. Center = effect off. Push UP to the HOLD detent = effect latched on until returned to center. Pull DOWN = effect on only while held, springs back to center [IM][LBL]. Sends CENTER = 00, HOLD/ON = 7F [MM].

controls.name: fx_on_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + paddle: TRACK BACKSPIN [LL].

controls.name: fx_on_led
controls.function: Indicator for the FX paddle state, output only, on the paddle's own note [MM].

controls.name: fx_dry_wet
controls.function: Effect intensity for the selected effect, dry (off) to wet; ONE knob for both decks [IM]. One shared global CC, not one per deck [HW].

controls.name: fx_dry_wet_mode
controls.function: MODE + turn: per-deck FX parameter on the FX-unit channel of the deck whose MODE is held [MM]. djay function not documented in [IM].

controls.name: param_prev
controls.function: FX parameter step (decrease / increase) for the active effect, affects both decks [IM].

controls.name: param_prev_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + PARAM: separate address on an FX-unit channel [MM]; function not documented in [IM]. SHIFT has no side, so which deck's FX unit receives it is not documented (ASSUMED: the deck last addressed by MODE); both sides are shown.

controls.name: param_prev_mode
controls.function: MODE + PARAM: FX SELECT, previous / next effect [IM][LBL]. 'When MODE is held the MIDI layer switches for both buttons' [MM]; sent on the FX-unit channel of the deck whose MODE is held, verified 0B / 0C on hardware [HW].

controls.name: param_next
controls.function: FX parameter step (decrease / increase) for the active effect, affects both decks [IM].

controls.name: param_next_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + PARAM: separate address on an FX-unit channel [MM]; function not documented in [IM]. SHIFT has no side, so which deck's FX unit receives it is not documented (ASSUMED: the deck last addressed by MODE); both sides are shown.

controls.name: param_next_mode
controls.function: MODE + PARAM: FX SELECT, previous / next effect [IM][LBL]. 'When MODE is held the MIDI layer switches for both buttons' [MM]; sent on the FX-unit channel of the deck whose MODE is held, verified 0B / 0C on hardware [HW].

controls.name: in_out_ex
controls.function: Manual loop: 1st press = loop IN, 2nd press = loop OUT (loop starts), 3rd press = EXIT loop [IM].

controls.name: in_out_ex_shift
controls.function: SHIFT: AUTO LOOP, set an automatic loop [IM][LBL].

controls.name: in_out_ex_mode
controls.function: MODE: LOOP HALF, halve the loop length [LL].

controls.name: in_out_ex_shift_mode
controls.notes: SHIFT + MODE of IN > OUT > EX [in_out_ex]
controls.function: SHIFT + MODE: LOOP IN / MOVE, then move the loop-in point (djay shows the in point flashing white while it is movable) [LL][FORUM].

controls.name: sync
controls.function: Match this deck's BPM to the other deck; press again to switch SYNC off [IM].

controls.name: sync_shift
controls.function: SHIFT: KEY MATCH, match the musical key to the playing track [IM][LBL].

controls.name: sync_mode
controls.function: MODE: LOOP DOUBLE, double the loop length [LL].

controls.name: sync_shift_mode
controls.function: SHIFT + MODE: LOOP OUT / MOVE, then move the loop-out point (flashing white indicator) [LL][FORUM].

controls.name: cue
controls.function: Temporary cue: while playing, press = stop and jump back to the cue point; while paused, press = set a new cue point at the current position [IM].

controls.name: cue_shift
controls.function: SHIFT: PITCH BEND -, bend the pitch down while held [IM][LBL].

controls.name: cue_mode
controls.function: MODE: KEY -, musical key one step down [IM][LBL].

controls.name: cue_shift_mode
controls.function: SHIFT + MODE: TEMPO - in 0.1 BPM steps [LL]. Repeats while held [HW].

controls.name: play_pause
controls.function: Start / pause playback of this deck [IM].

controls.name: play_pause_shift
controls.function: SHIFT: PITCH BEND +, bend the pitch up while held [IM][LBL].

controls.name: play_pause_mode
controls.function: MODE: KEY +, musical key one step up [IM][LBL].

controls.name: play_pause_shift_mode
controls.function: SHIFT + MODE: TEMPO + in 0.1 BPM steps [LL]. Repeats while held [HW].

controls.name: shift
controls.function: Modifier: hold SHIFT and press a control for the second-layer function printed on the label (shift-arrow icon) [IM]. Global note; hardware SHIFT changes the NOTE/CC the other control sends rather than adding a modifier bit [MM][HW].

controls.name: crossfader
controls.function: Blend between the left and right channels (Crossfader Fusion transitions when CFX is on) [IM].

controls.name: crossfader_shift
controls.function: SHIFT + move crossfader: FADER START, CUE = 00 / PLAY = 7F; the MIDI channel follows the deck active on each side (left end = left deck, right end = right deck) [MM].

controls.name: cue_vol
controls.function: Headphone volume [IM].

controls.name: cue_mix
controls.function: Headphone blend between the cued channel (CUE) and the master signal (MAIN) [IM][LBL].

controls.name: mono_stereo
controls.function: Front-panel slide switch: master out in stereo or mono [IM]. Reported to the software as a note, STEREO = 00, MONO = 7F [MM].
